nodes.label: Fault F22.1 — Latter clamp applied to SIC-bearing channels
PZ-81 SIC already supplies the -1/r tail
nodes.rationale: PZ-81 Sec. II: orbital SIC supplies -1/r by construction, so no Latter tail should be applied to a channel that already carries a SIC term. Symptoms: H 1s half-occupied exchange-SIC eps -0.533 instead of -0.500; one-orbital correlation self-term removed to 0.0014 rather than 1e-4. Repair is SIC_NOCLAMP=1; banked rows deliberately not regenerated (budget).
